title: From an answer (A): after the pass and the record, the last line hands back to the answer's next step ('That was step 1; next is ...') and nothing follows it

steps.text: Select Title's Position, Scale and Opacity keys and choose Easy Ease (F9), so it lands softer.
Play it back and watch how Title lands.

turns.say: I eased all of Title's pairs. Done.

say_ends_with.pattern: ^That was step 1[;.] next is (?:step 2: )?(?:to )?play it back and watch how Title lands

note: Spec 014 T079. The hand-back text is the next step's own words from the seeded answer (the tool's hand_back); the line may say 'step 2:' or 'to'. 'Nothing after it' is the last sentence of the turn. Easing has no understanding check after the pass, so the record comes in the pass turn.
